headline: NU Colombia Joins CENIT Payment System
summary: The Colombian central bank has authorized NU Colombia Compañía de Financiamiento S.A. as a new participant in the CENIT payment system.
why: CENIT is a critical component of Colombia's financial infrastructure for interbank settlements. The inclusion of a digital-first financial institution signals the ongoing modernization and expansion of the country's electronic payment ecosystem.

impacts.name: Nu Holdings
impacts.why: Integration into national payment systems expands the company's operational capabilities and market reach in Colombia.
